content:
Monitors the clipboard every second
Only logs new content when it changes (avoids duplicates)
Includes timestamps with each entry
Saves data in CSV format for easy analysis
Creates the CSV file if it doesn't exist, appends to it if it does

The program will run until you stop it with Ctrl+C. The CSV file
The program will run until you stop it with Ctrl+C. The CSV file (clipboard_history.csv) will be created in the same directory as the executable.
